newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWISS FRANC ENDS BETWEEN WEAK DOLLAR, STRONG MARK.
newsitem.headline: SWISS FRANC ENDS BETWEEN WEAK DOLLAR, STRONG MARK.

text.p: 1440 GMT - The Swiss franc closed two centimes stronger against the dollar as the U.S. currency came under pressure from mark buying on a Bundesbank warning that German inflation had picked up.

Mark/Swiss also rose as the German unit gained in crosses. * Dollar closed at 1.5070/5078 Swuss francs vs opening 1.5222/5230 and yesterday's closer of 1.5270/5278. * Mark ended at 82.36/39 centimes vs opening 81.97/00 and overnight 81.88/90.
In busy end of day trading, the dollar was moving in a range of 1.5050/5100.
The mark was confined between 82.30 and 82.39, traders said.
